requirement_text: Provide a ShoppingBasket class in shopping_basket.py. A new basket is empty. Calling add_item(name, price) adds one item with a non-negative integer price. Calling item_count() returns the number of items. Calling total_price() returns the sum of all item prices. Adding bread for 3 and milk for 2 must produce an item count of 2 and a total price of 5. Keep all state in memory and use no external dependencies.

clauses.ref: Provide a ShoppingBasket class in shopping_basket.py
clauses.source_quote: Provide a ShoppingBasket class in shopping_basket.py
clauses.subject: ShoppingBasket class
clauses.text: The system shall provide a ShoppingBasket class in the file shopping_basket.py.

clauses.subject: new basket
clauses.text: A newly instantiated ShoppingBasket must be empty.

clauses.ref: Calling add_item(name, price) adds one item
clauses.source_quote: Calling add_item(name, price) adds one item
clauses.subject: add_item(name, price)
clauses.text: Calling add_item(name, price) shall add one item to the basket.

clauses.subject: non-negative integer price
clauses.text: The price provided to add_item must be a non-negative integer.

clauses.ref: Calling item_count() returns the number of items
clauses.source_quote: Calling item_count() returns the number of items
clauses.subject: item_count()
clauses.text: Calling item_count() shall return the total number of items in the basket.

clauses.ref: Calling total_price() returns the sum of all item prices
clauses.source_quote: Calling total_price() returns the sum of all item prices
clauses.subject: total_price()
clauses.text: Calling total_price() shall return the sum of all item prices in the basket.

clauses.ref: Adding bread for 3 and milk for 2 must produce an item count of 2 and a total price of 5
clauses.source_quote: Adding bread for 3 and milk for 2 must produce an item count of 2 and a total price of 5
clauses.subject: bread for 3 and milk for 2
clauses.text: Adding bread for 3 and milk for 2 must result in an item count of 2 and a total price of 5.

clauses.subject: state
clauses.text: All state must be kept in memory.

clauses.subject: external dependencies
clauses.text: The system shall use no external dependencies.
